verdict.rationale: Open-source licensing is a fair question for any software product, including a SaaS identity-verification platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Sumsub publishing its source under an open license. The docs only cover proprietary APIs, SDKs, a React package and an MCP server, and none of them mention source availability or a license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
